description: Codon-optimize a protein (or coding DNA) for an expression host by picking the most-frequent codon per residue.

inputType.description: How to read `protein`. 'auto' guesses from the alphabet (>90% ACGTUN reads as DNA), which mis-files genuine Ala/Cys/Gly/Thr/Asn-only peptides — set 'protein' or 'dna' to force it.

protein.description: Protein sequence (one-letter codes). Coding DNA/RNA is accepted and translated in frame +1 up to the first stop codon (residues after an in-frame stop are NOT optimized).

name: codon_optimize
title: Codon optimizer
